# B3D natives

<!-- generated by `x3kc natives-ref` from docs/natives/spec_*.jsonl; do not edit by hand, regenerate -->

## Natives of the exes

### B3D_InstAlloc

    B3D_InstAlloc()

returns int: new node handle, 0 on failure; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 0, FL 0; handler `0x00493b84` (AP), `0x004afc48` (FL); confidence high.

**Allocates a new empty 3D instance node (no body) and returns its handle.**

Node::Alloc: zeroed Node, handle from the node map (hashMapAutoId), bodyId -1, identity rotation, scale 1.0, size 0, saturation/colour modifiers 1.0, hue 0; linked into the render manager's unattached list (in no scene). Returns the handle, or 0 when memory or the handle fail. The node is owned by the engine until B3D_InstFree; it is not saved with script variables (only the B3D world block of the savegame keeps nodes). Arguments ignored. Typical use: B3D_InstAlloc, B3D_InstSetBody, B3D_InstAddToScene or B3D_InstAddToInst.

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** same

### B3D_LightAlloc

    B3D_LightAlloc()

returns int: new light node handle, 0 on failure; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 1, FL 1; handler `0x00493f80` (AP), `0x004b009b` (FL); confidence high.

**Allocates a new light node (Light flag, no body) and returns its handle.**

Scene::AllocLightNode: like B3D_InstAlloc but the node gets the Light flag 0x4 and no body; it is a light only once added to a scene and given parameters (B3D_LightSetParameters/Color/Range/Attenuation/Pos). Returns the handle or 0. Free with B3D_LightFree (same code as B3D_InstFree).

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** same

### B3D_InstFree

    B3D_InstFree(inst:int)

returns int: always 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 2, FL 2; handler `0x00493bba` (AP), `0x004afc7a` (FL); confidence high.

**Frees a node and, recursively, all its children.**

inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Found: Node::ReleaseNode - frees its UV animation storage and GPU buffer, notifies a pending J3D animation callback (a task waiting in J3D_JobStart/JobPlay on it is resumed with code 3), releases all children recursively, detaches it from its scene, frees its link table, lens records, names and the node itself, and removes the handle from the map. The handle is dead afterwards (reusing it in other natives returns "not found", except B3D_InstFind/CameraFind continuation which crashes, see there). Not found: nothing. Always answers 0.

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** same

### B3D_InstSetBody

    B3D_InstSetBody(inst:int, body:int)

returns int: 1 ok / 0 failed; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 3, FL 3; handler `0x00493be6` (AP), `0x004afca3` (FL); confidence high.

**Assigns a body (3D model) to a node by body id; returns 1 on success.**

inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. body = body id (from B3D_GetBodyID or a numeric id). Scene::SetNodeModel: if the node already has this same non-zero body it returns 1 without change. Else AP: body \< 0 -> 0. Mesh::GetBody(body) (loads the body if needed) NULL -> 0. Otherwise: flagged child nodes released, render resources released (if in an enabled scene), UV animation and extra buffers freed, bodyId set, size = body LOD0 scale, scale reset to 1.0, radius = size, name = body name; body flag 0x40 sets node Hidden + NoCollisionTree, body flag 0x8 sets flags2 0x20; body texture animations collected; collision trees built for LODs flagged 0x10; render resources acquired again in an enabled scene. Returns 1. Node not found -> 0.

- **FL:** differs: FL Scene::SetNodeModel (0x004a35e0) has no body \< 0 test, a negative id goes straight to Mesh::GetBody (expected NULL -> 0; not verified in FL)
- **x3_src:** differs: B155 - a node with a fixed LOD (B3D_InstSetSizeUsed) gets lodIndex clamped to the new body's last LOD (the original kept it and the renderer read past the LOD array); also the remake keeps a use count on the body (holdBody), not observable

### B3D_SetEngineFlags

    B3D_SetEngineFlags(flags:int)

returns int: the new engine flags; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 19, FL 19; handler `0x004946c2` (AP), `0x004b08be` (FL); confidence medium.

**ORs bits into the 3D engine flags and returns the result.**

RenderManager+0x24 \|= arg1; answers the new value. Known bits: 0x1 frame recording active (also records texture draws), 0x2 frame replay active, 0x20 cut-file names in use, 0x80 engine-internal; the rest are not named. Setting 0x1/0x2 by hand fakes a recording/replay state without a recorder (B3D_InitRecording/InitReplay then refuse, ExitRecording/ExitReplay run on a NULL recorder - safe, they only clear). Values are read as raw cell dwords; cell types are not checked.

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** same

The camera is only checked for existence (its fields are not used). Answers (int) min(2500, atan2(width/65536 / ((dist/65536) \* (scale \* 0.01)), 1) \* 10000/pi) (x87 80-bit, truncation). width and dist are 16.16, scale an integer percent-like factor (0.01 = the cockpit scene scale). Units of the result: 10000 = pi radians, so 2500 = 45 degrees. 0 when the camera is not found. A zero denominator gives atan2(inf) = 5000 -> clamped 2500.

### B3D_InitReplay

returns int: 1 started / 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 89, FL 91; handler `0x00495b5f` (AP), `0x004b1def` (FL); confidence medium.

**Starts replaying a frame recording "\<name>.rec" into a viewport rectangle.**

If engine flags & 3 == 0: Save::StartFramePlayback(name, layerBias, left, right, top, bottom): opens \<name>.rec, sets engine flag 0x2, checks the RECO/RNAM/RFRA header, loads the body names; recorded camera viewports are mapped into the 16.16 rectangle (left, right, top, bottom) and layerBias is added to recorded camera layers. Answers its result; 0 when already recording/replaying. In the ORIGINAL the RNAM tag is compared over 5 bytes of a 4-byte buffer, so the check always fails and a recording never plays; on that failure the player and flag 0x2 stay set (B3D_ExitReplay needed before any new Init).

- **FL:** same handler; FL Save::StartFramePlayback 0x0048efa0 not checked for the B14 compare
- **x3_src:** differs: B14 fixed - recordings play
- **Bug:** RNAM compared with REPE CMPSB over 5 bytes (5th byte = return address byte 0x91): playback never starts; failed start leaves flag 0x2 and the player set. AP Save::StartFramePlayback 0x00475b10 (call 0x00495b8c). Script sees: 0 from every replay; recording/replay natives refuse until B3D_ExitReplay. x3_src: fixed (4-byte compare; a failed start cleans up). bugs.md: B14 (bugs_fixed.md).

### B3D_TexRectFill

    B3D_TexRectFill(tex:int, x:int, y:int, w:int, h:int, color:int)

**Fills a rectangle on a texture with a colour.**

tex = texture id (B3D_GetTextureID); a NEGATIVE id names a composite texture (texture animation row -id made of tiles): the operation is applied to every tile it overlaps, with coordinates in the composite's space. Textures whose material row has flag 0x10000 (font-scaled) take coordinates in logical units, multiplied by the engine font scale. ### B3D_TexTextBlock

    B3D_TexTextBlock(tex:int, text:string, font:int, x:int, y:int, right:int, color:int, flags:int)

returns int: number of lines drawn (0 on failure); answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 94, FL 96; handler `0x00495c3e` (AP), `0x004b1ec1` (FL); confidence medium.

**Draws word-wrapped text into a texture between x and right; returns the line count.**

tex = texture id (B3D_GetTextureID); a NEGATIVE id names a composite texture (texture animation row -id made of tiles): the operation is applied to every tile it overlaps, with coordinates in the composite's space. Textures whose material row has flag 0x10000 (font-scaled) take coordinates in logical units, multiplied by the engine font scale. font = font slot 0..9 returned by B3D_OpenFont. arg2 must be a string cell (type 2 or 0x0b), else 0 and nothing drawn. right \<= 0: for a composite tex right += its rightmost tile edge; for a plain tex with the font-scale material flag right += width/fontScale, WITHOUT the flag right = surface width (the negative offset is dropped). The text is wrapped (Font::WrapTextLines, max 100 lines) to (right - x) \* fontScale, the style passes of flags (style mask) are built, and each line is drawn with Font::TexTextLine at y + i \* lineStep (lineStep = cell height + style extent, / fontScale). flags = style bits (shadow/outline/bold etc.) plus wrap options. Answers the number of lines.

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: B153, B154
- **Bug 1:** font slot unchecked: out of 0..9 or an unopened slot is dereferenced. AP Font::TexTextBlock 0x0048b4b0. Script sees: crash with a bad font number. x3_src: fixed (0, nothing drawn). bugs.md: B154.
- **Bug 2:** negative tex outside the animation table read unchecked. AP 0x0048b4b0. Script sees: crash/garbage. x3_src: fixed. bugs.md: B153.
- **Bug 3:** right \<= 0 is treated as an offset from the right edge only for composite or font-scaled textures; on a plain texture it becomes the full width (inconsistent, probably unintended). AP 0x0048b4b0. Script sees: a negative right margin ignored on plain textures. x3_src: reproduces.

### B3D_TexBltImage

### B3D_InstDistanceToNearestVertex

    B3D_InstDistanceToNearestVertex(inst:int, x:int, y:int, z:int, lod:int)

returns int: distance (engine units), -1 if none; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 124, FL 126; handler `0x00494e26` (AP), `0x004b1098` (FL); confidence medium.

**Returns the distance from a world point to the nearest vertex of a node's subtree.**

inst = node handle, looked up in the render manager's node map (Scene::NodeFromHandle; 0 or an unknown/freed handle -> not found). Node, light and camera handles share that map, so any of them is accepted here. Not found -> -1. The point (x, y, z) (scene/world coordinates) is moved into the node's frame (subtract world position, multiply by world rotation rows); Scene::NearestVertexDistance walks the node and its subtree, using LOD lod of each body (lod >= count -> last LOD), and answers the distance to the nearest vertex (engine length units), -1 when there is no vertex. World pos/rot are those of the last transform walk.

### B3D_SetGammaValue

    B3D_SetGammaValue(level:int)

returns int: always 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 126, FL 128; handler `0x0049633a` (AP), `0x004b255c` (FL); confidence medium.

**Sets the display gamma level (meant 0..255).**

AP: Render::SetGammaLevel(level): stores the level at RenderManager+0x6968 and builds the gamma ramp (Render::SetGammaRamp: the same ramp on 3 channels, exponent = log(level/255)/log(0.5), so 128 is about linear, larger brightens; level 0 gives log(0)). ### B3D_TexTextBlockCentered

    B3D_TexTextBlockCentered(tex:int, text:string, font:int, x:int, y:int, width:int, anchorY:int, color:int, flags:int)

returns int: number of lines drawn; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 138, FL 140; handler `0x00495d17` (AP), `0x004b1f8b` (FL); confidence medium.

**Draws word-wrapped text into a texture, each line centred in a width, bottom-anchored.**

tex = texture id (B3D_GetTextureID); a NEGATIVE id names a composite texture (texture animation row -id made of tiles): the operation is applied to every tile it overlaps, with coordinates in the composite's space. Textures whose material row has flag 0x10000 (font-scaled) take coordinates in logical units, multiplied by the engine font scale. font = font slot 0..9 returned by B3D_OpenFont. arg2 must be a string cell, else 0. Text wrapped to width \* fontScale; first line y = y + anchorY - wrapped block height; each line drawn at x + (width - lineWidth/fontScale)/2, right limit x + width, line step as TexTextBlock. Answers the line count.

- **FL:** same
- **x3_src:** differs: B154
- **Bug:** font slot unchecked. AP Font::TexTextBlockCentered 0x0048b770. Script sees: crash. x3_src: fixed. bugs.md: B154.

### B3D_SetScreenOverlay

    B3D_SetScreenOverlay(name:string, tiled:int)

returns int: always 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 142, FL 144; handler `0x004966d6` (AP), `0x004b28b9` (FL); confidence medium.

**Shows a full-screen image overlay built from textures "\<name>_diff" and "\<name>_alpha8".**

Stores a copy of name (RenderManager screen image name, old one freed) and arg2 (+0x6a44). Each frame Render::DrawNamedScreenImage draws a full-screen quad textured with \<name>_diff (colour) and \<name>_alpha8 (alpha); arg2 != 0 tiles the texture at its native size, 0 stretches it. Stays until B3D_ClearScreenOverlay. A non-string name clears the name (no overlay). Always 0.
